description.fr: Le feutre reste au-dessus de la languette. Elle a envie de laisser sa trace, mais hésite encore.

assets.prompt: Targeted continuity edit of this supplied SINGLE painted Luna frame. Keep exact camera, framing, fifteen-year-old Luna identity/age/low curly ponytail, shirt, trousers, pose of supporting left hand, shoe, trunk, lighting and every background object fixed. DO NOT recast or smooth her painted face. Change her RIGHT marker hand and forearm ONLY into an unmistakably interrupted hesitant gesture: LIFT the existing ivory-barrel felt marker and its right hand STRAIGHT UP by a visible 8 centimetres (roughly one-third of the shoe ankle height). The tip must be visibly separated from ALL shoe fabric by a LARGE clear gap and point diagonally DOWN toward the BLANK space to the RIGHT of R.M. It is not writing. Her right elbow stays natural close to her body. Preserve just R.M. inside the cream tongue exactly; NO new letters or ink. Slightly tighten her lips and raise the inner eyebrows for uncertainty while eyes remain focused on the old initials. She is about to pull away, not concentrating on drawing. Keep the full black RIGHT high-top silhouette and small cream repair exactly on outer forefoot. Correct the two stray little ventilation eyelets in the plain outer side behind the repair: remove those two side holes by restoring black canvas; keep every lace eyelet and lace unchanged. Outer ankle remains plain with no circular badge. Same consistent handpainted gouache brush planes on face/hands and warm paper grain. Five plausible fingers each hand. No extra person, shoe, limb, props, text, camera motion or crop.

qa.fr: Correction : le feutre est nettement séparé de la languette, R.M. intact et espace voisin vide. Visage, coiffure et cadre conservés ; les œillets latéraux erronés ont disparu. L’arrêt puis le retrait du geste restent à valider en mouvement.
qa.en: Refined: marker clearly separated from the tongue, R.M. intact and adjacent space blank. Face, hair and framing preserved; stray side eyelets removed. Validate pause and retreat in motion.

REFERENCE2 is D06 attic geometry and warm daylight; use its low angle. REFERENCE3 supplies Luna's PLAIN SOLID OLIVE cargo cloth only; do not copy sheet layout or show face. SINGLE CLOSE-UP: ONE RIGHT SHOE in strict OUTER side profile, toe points screen LEFT, heel screen RIGHT; lens axis perpendicular to shoe, ground-level 70mm perspective, absolutely no three-quarter angle. Shoe spans EXACTLY 45% of total image width, from x=27.5% at toe to x=72.5% at heel; bottom of sole lies flat horizontally at y=75% of image height. The sole is narrow flat ivory vulcanized rubber, toe cap ivory, laces off-white and normally tied, silver eyelets. Controlled worn black canvas and mildly aged rubber. One SMALL rectangular cream stitched repair about 2cm wide on OUTER forefoot canvas just above rubber, as reference1; not on ankle or rubber. assets.prompt: Create ONE cinematic film keyframe, landscape 16:9, full bleed; no collage, panels, text captions, borders, watermark or labels. Entire image is an expressive HAND-PAINTED GOUACHE AND WATERCOLOR illustration on textured paper, with visible broad opaque brush planes, dry-brush edges, pigment granulation and restrained pencil contours. Crucially the FACES, hands and skin must be visibly painted in exactly the same physical medium as clothing and architecture: cheeks/noses built from planar brush shapes, hair from grouped strokes, expressive eyes with small paint marks, preserved exact referenced facial identity, ordinary natural proportions. No photo-smooth or airbrushed face pasted into a painting; no hyperreal pores, glossy CGI, cel anime, cartoon recasting, glamorous replacement, or orange accessories. Keep identities and costume from named references. References are continuity sheets, not layouts to reproduce. One coherent moment, clear human gesture, warm memory palette, precise anatomically plausible hands and feet. REFERENCE1 fixes Rafa at age16: same youthful warm-brown face, broad rounded nose, short dense black curls, no moustache, slim teenage build, white basketball tank, navy shorts, white tube socks with TWO burgundy stripes. REFERENCE2 fixes Bronx1970 court: chain-link fence, left hoop with old cream backboard, brick apartments and fire escapes, distinctive masonry arch in rear right. REFERENCE3 fixes black Chuck Taylor high-tops, thin cream rubber sole and toe, cream laces, round star ONLY on inner ankles, no repair patch in this era. COMPOSITION: low but natural camera about waist height, 35mm equivalent medium-wide three-quarter full body of ONE Rafa, central-right in frame; whole face and both complete shoes readable, enough environment to recognize left hoop and right arch. After a missed shot, the ball has rolled back; Rafa has just gathered ONE worn orange-brown basketball beside his left knee with both hands and is straightening, knees slightly bent, his weight shifting onto the right shoe. He glances toward the basket with a small forgiving smile, ready to try again, sweat conveyed by tiny painted highlights, not photoreal sweat. A subtle ordinary scuff at outer right shoe forefoot, no patch. Gentle late afternoon sunlight from left, slightly cooler shadows, empty neighborhood court. Ball is securely between hands not levitating; no victory pose, no dunk, no crowd, no scoreboard.

qa.fr: Rafa et sa tenue de 1970 sont reconnaissables ; visage traité en gouache, ballon tenu, panier gauche et arche droite conservés. Deux chaussures noires, sans réparation ; badge visible sur la face intérieure du pied gauche. L’image fixe montre la reprise d’appui ; le panier manqué devra être raconté par le plan précédent.
qa.en: Recognizable Rafa and 1970 outfit; gouache-rendered face, held ball, left hoop and right arch preserved. Two black shoes without repair; visible badge on left inner ankle. The still shows resetting his stance; the missed shot needs the preceding shot.

assets.prompt: A quiet SIX SECOND silent hand-painted animation shot, landscape16:9. Use the supplied painted frame as the exact starting composition and identity, no titles. SAME fictional15-year-old Luna, low curly ponytail, charcoal tee, olive cargos, D06 attic and window atleft, same mature physical black RIGHT high-top Converse in her lap, small cream repair outerforefoot. Preserve all facial anatomy and youthful proportions. Skin, lips and eyes MUST remain painted with visible small gouache planes and brush edges throughout movement, same medium as painted hair, clothes and room. No photoreal smooth face pasted onto painting, no beauty retouching, no new actor, no glossy3D. Locked50mm camera; no push-in or reframing. 0.0–1.5s: Luna looks down at the old R.M. inside the tongue; her right hand holding the ivory-barrel fine black marker approaches the empty fabric to the RIGHT of those letters slowly. 1.5–3.5s: stop the marker clearly at least2cm ABOVE the fabric, a visible air gap. Her brow tightens slightly and her eyes linger on R.M.; she hesitates. 3.5–6.0s: she draws the marker hand back several centimetres toward her chest without touching the shoe, with a tiny exhale visible in her shoulders. Her left hand and shoe remain stable. Important: NOTHING is written. The exact original R.M. remains unchanged, no L.M. appears, no inkline emerges. Shoe never rotates, grows, becomes leftfoot, or changesmaterial. Matching leftshoe remains on floor atbackgroundright. Exactlytwohands andfingers, noextra objects. Subtle natural blinking once only, restrained emotion. At finalframe marker is visibly awayfromshoe and Luna's unresolved hesitation remains. No music, dialogue, voiceover, or sound.

qa.fr: Le froncement des sourcils et le retrait du feutre se lisent, R.M. reste seul. Mais Seedance lisse à nouveau le visage : la matière de peau devient plus photographique que le décor. Test de jeu utile, rendu pictural à reprendre avant la production des visages. Source : première K01, avant correction de la main.
qa.en: The brow tension and marker retreat read, and R.M. remains alone. However, Seedance smooths the face again: skin becomes more photographic than the setting. Useful acting test; painted surface needs work before producing face scenes. Source: first K01, before the hand refinement.

description.en: Silent6s footfall transition test. The model produced a dissolve instead of the requested cut.

assets.prompt: Create ONE SILENT 6-second 16:9 hand-painted film transition proof, with precisely TWO shots joined by ONE CLEAN MATCH CUT. REFERENCE IMAGE1 is the PRESENT shot: Luna's single right black high-top Chuck Taylor in outer side profile in D06 attic, toe LEFT, plain olive cargo above, small cream rectangular fabric repair at outer forefoot, warm left window light and wood floor. REFERENCE IMAGE2 is the MEMORY shot: SAME right shoe and near-identical screen composition on a 1970 Bronx basketball court, white sport sock with two burgundy stripes, NO repair patch. The actual images are the composition, material and product references; keep them recognizable. TIMING: 0.0-2.4s stay entirely in the ATTIC: locked ground-level camera, one lower leg, shoe remains about57% of frame width and sole near76% height, all toe/heel within frame; very subtle natural ankle weight shift and heel gently settles onto wood. This is a cautious footfall, not a stomp, jump or step across the frame. The cream repair stays clearly present throughout this shot. AT approximately2.5s make one motivated instantaneous editorial MATCH CUT on the end of the footfall to the COURT shot from IMAGE2. The shoe's outline, toe-left direction, scale and sole contact should match as closely as the two references allow. This is a CUT BETWEEN TWO PLACES/TIMES, NOT an in-shot metamorphosis. Do not morph wood into asphalt or olive fabric into sock, and do not dissolve the repair. 2.5-6.0s stay entirely on the COURT: same fixed camera and screen position, white sock, two burgundy bands, outer canvas with NO cream patch, slight natural weight settling, tiny lace response, grounded heel and toe. No additional stepping, no new props. Consistent tactile opaque GOUACHE / WATERCOLOR brush planes on warm paper across BOTH shots, same painted shoe and cloth construction, same broad restrained colors, no live action, no photographic textures, no3D gloss. Important product continuity: narrow flat ivory sole, ivory toe cap, black canvas ankle-high upper, offwhite tied laces; visible side is RIGHT OUTER face, NEVER add a circular star badge to this exterior. Exactly one shoe and one cropped lower leg per shot. No second foot, no hands, no face, no basketball, no portal, no cloth or rubber morph, no wobbly sole, no camera zoom/pan/tilt, no flashes, no particles, no text or logo overlay. Keep left-side light and maintain toe LEFT throughout; no horizontal flip. No audio, no speech, no music, no sound effects. End on the quiet court footfall so the next shot can reveal young Rafa.

qa.fr: Matière peinte, profil extérieur sans faux badge, une seule chaussure et mouvement discret conservés. Échec du raccord demandé : fondu global vers2,0–2,8s, superposition cargo/chaussette, grenier/terrain et effacement progressif du patch, au lieu d’une coupe franche. Le talon semble légèrement se soulever puis revenir. À conserver comme diagnostic, pas à intégrer tel quel dans le film.
qa.en: Painted material, exterior profile without false badge, single shoe and restrained motion retained. Requested cut failed: global dissolve around2.0–2.8s overlays cargo/sock and attic/court while the repair gradually disappears, instead of a clean cut. Heel appears to lift slightly then return. Keep as a diagnostic, not a production-ready transition.
